transcript.text: Visitor: Hi there, I heard about the Upper Provence Folk Festival and I'm interested in attending.
When is it happening this year?
Staff: This year's Upper Provence Folk Festival will be held on a weekend in June.
Traditionally, it has always been held in May.
Visitor: That's great to know.
I'm planning to bring my kids along.
One is 14 years old and the other is 13 years old.
Staff: I'm sorry, but they need to purchase tickets.
Only children aged 12 or younger can participate in this event for free.
Visitor: Wonderful.
Where exactly is the festival taking place?
Staff: The festival will be held at Donaldson Farm.
The owner, who is a music lover, has graciously sponsored this event.
I'll spell the name for you to help you locate it.
D-O-N-A-L-S-O-N. D-O-N-A-L-S-O-N。
Visitor: That sounds like a perfect location.
How can I purchase tickets for the festival?
Staff: To participate in the event, you will need to purchase a combined ticket that allows you
access to all activities.
Buying single tickets for each activity separately can result in significant fees when accumulated.
Visitor: I see, what is the schedule for the festival?
When should I arrive?
Staff: The festival is scheduled to start on Saturday, but the camping service is provided on a first
come, first served basis.
It is recommended to arrive on Thursday to secure your camping spot.
Visitor: Good to know.
Is there anything else I should be aware of while camping?
Staff: It is strongly recommended to bring a light with you as it can get very dark at night
and it's important to ensure the safety of your children.
Visitor: Thank you for the advice.
Are there any special activities for children?
Staff: Yes, we have a wide range of options for children, including campfire singalongs and nature walks.
One of the highlights is the opportunity for children to attend a concert on the last night, where
they can even perform music with professional musicians.
So you can bring your musical instruments if you want.
Visitor: That's good to know.
What are some essential items we should bring?
Staff: Some essential items to bring include sunscreen.
Camping often involves spending a significant amount of time outdoors exposed to the sun's
rays.
It is important to protect your skin.
Visitor: That sounds like a lot of fun.
If someone gets injured or feels unwell during the festival.
Staff: The emergency station in the camp can handle minor injuries, mosquito bites and headaches.
However, participants should bring their own medicine if they have allergies or asthma.
Visitor: Is there a medical professional available on site?
Staff: Yes, there will be a nurse available at all times.
You can consult her if your children feel uncomfortable or have ailments.
Additionally, the camping area has hired a doctor as a consultant who will be located
in the nearby town.
The doctor will be present in the camp only when there is a need to address complicated
medical conditions.
Visitor: Thank you so much for answering all my questions.
Staff: You're welcome.
If you have any more questions or need further assistance, feel free to reach out.
We're here to help. Enjoy the festival.
